item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00253","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C12","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.74,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child's provisions on governmental representation and preservation of existing membership. Both directives specify an interagency body's membership through representatives designated by agency heads and conclude with a continuity clause preventing the new order from requiring replacement or redesignation of current members. C12 is strongly related to scientific research and interagency cooperation, but its similarities are mainly substantive rather than close drafting machinery. C14 also concerns a council with specified governmental members, but has less parallel operative structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Government shall be represented on the Council by members who are officers or employees of specified departments and agencies... The head of each such specified department or agency shall designate the officers and employees... who shall be members of the Council","parent_excerpt":"The Air Coordinating Committee... shall have as members one representative from each of the following-named agencies... The members of the Committee shall be designated by the respective heads of the member agencies.","explanation":"Both use the same membership mechanism: representation by specified agencies, with each agency head designating the serving representative or representatives."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall not be construed as terminating the tenure of any person who has heretofore been designated as a member of the Council.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall not be construed as necessitating the redesignation of members of the Committee... serving on the date hereof.","explanation":"These unusually similar continuity clauses preserve the status of incumbent members notwithstanding revision of the body's governing order."}]}
